speaker: johan_vosloo
headline: AUTHORITY IS LEGITIMATE ONLY WHEN IT CAN BE CHECKED.
deck: Mandate and enforcement must pass through limits, review and disclosure before power can claim durable legitimacy.
quote: Oversight is not an obstacle to authority. It is what prevents authority from becoming arbitrary.
facts: A clear mandate defines what the institution may do.
Limits define what the institution may not do.
Independent review tests whether power stayed inside those limits.
Disclosure lets the public see the result.
takeaway: The strongest institutions make scrutiny part of the architecture of power rather than an afterthought.
